stylesheets.description: A comma-separated list of custom stylesheets to load.

stylesheet_path.description: A colon-separated list of folders to search for stylesheets.

font_path.description: A colon-separated list of folders to search for fonts.

baseurl.description: The base URL for relative URLs in the document.

language.description: Language to be used for hyphenation and docutils localization. Empty string or 'None' for default.

header.description: Page header text if not specified in the document.

footer.description: Page footer text if not specified in the document.

section_header_depth.description: Sections up to this depth will be used in the header and footer's replacement of ###Section###.

fit_literal_mode.description: What to do when a literal is too wide. One of error, overflow, shrink, truncate.

fit_background_mode.description: How to fit the background image to the page. One of scale, scale_width, center.

inline_links.description: Shows target between parenthesis instead of active link.

repeat_table_rows.description: Repeats header row for each splitted table.

default_dpi.description: DPI for objects sized in pixels.

show_frame_boundary.description: Show frame borders (only useful for debugging).

disable_splittables.description: Don't use splittable flowables in some elements.

break_level.description: Maximum section level that starts in a new page.

first_page_on_right.description: When using double sided pages, the first page will start on the right hand side.

blank_first_page.description: Add a blank page at the beginning of the document.

break_side.description: How section breaks work. Can be 'even', 'odd', or 'any'.

use_numbered_links.description: When using numbered sections, adds the numbers to all links referring to the section headers.

strip_elements_with_class.description: Remove elements with these CLASSes from the output.

record_dependencies.description: Write output file dependencies to FILE.

extension_module.description: Helper extension modules to load (must end in .py and be on python path).

custom_cover.description: Template file used for the cover page.

use_floating_images.description: Makes images with :align: attribute work more like in rst2html.
